(R-ui-polish-6, R-ui-polish-20) 10. **Layout**: the Invite link's size came only from its padding, so it was below 44 × 44 px. (R-ui-polish-7, R-ui-polish-20) 11. **Tokens**: these colours now use their role tokens, with the same values: `#ffffff` row surface becomes `var(--color-surface-default)`, `#202d2c` heading becomes `var(--color-text-default)`, `#4a6462` description becomes `var(--color-text-muted)`, and the link's `#0f766e` and `#ffffff` become `var(--color-action-primary-bg)` and `var(--color-action-primary-text)`. (R-ui-polish-20, R-ui-polish-21) 12. **Tokens**: font sizes now use tokens, with the same values: `18px` becomes `var(--font-size-lg)` and `12px` becomes `var(--font-size-xs)`. (R-ui-polish-20) 13. **Tokens**: radii now use tokens, with the same values: `9999px` becomes `var(--radius-full)` and `6px` becomes `var(--radius-control)`. (R-ui-polish-20) 14. **Tokens**: `font-family: system-ui` becomes `var(--font-family-sans)`.
